headline: Bernanke on ending $600B purchases *without tapering*
quote: We are going to do that pretty much without tapering.
title: Bernanke, Apr 2011: We will end $600B purchases without tapering
caption: Ben Bernanke confirmed the Federal Reserve would complete its $600 billion asset purchase program by the end of June 2011. He noted that the policy move was fully telegraphed to prevent financial market disruptions.
comment: Should central banks signal policy shifts months in advance?
